author: GamingBolt
description:
FM27 didn't need to reinvent Football Manager, FM26 tried to do that and failed. This year’s entry just had to get the fundamentals right and ensure that it captured that magic feeling that made all of us fall in love with Football Manager in the first place all those years ago. 

If you are a long-time fan, you will be glad to hear that this is a return to form for the series, and if you are a newcomer, then this is not a bad first experience of this franchise.

Note: Some official footage was used in this review.
title: Football Manager 27 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
The PlayStation 6 might be a while away, but that doesn’t stop us from being excited about a new generation of hardware from Sony and the new games that could benefit from it. But that doesn’t mean we’re prepared to leave our trusty PS5s behind, and we believe that the sentiment is echoed among many of you.

It was then a logical choice to look at how much Sony’s current-gen offering still has to give us, and examine how the PS6 could try to make us pay a premium to get our hands on it. 

Link to news report: https://gamingbolt.com/ps6-development-is-proceeding-as-scheduled-and-will-make-solid-progress-in-fiscal-year-2027
title: PS6 Is Making "Solid Progress" - But What Would Make Us Upgrade From PS5?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Once you've finished Phantom Blade Zero, and doubtless felt empty from the default ending, the question inevitably arises: What now? There's no proper end-game activity per se, but S-Game has stuffed the world with collectables, weapons, bosses, side quests and much more to discover. 

Those who only dabbled in the side content before venturing past the point of no return will have plenty to keep them busy, and that's before delving into the other difficulties.

Let's take a look at 15 things you can do after finishing Phantom Blade Zero.
title: Phantom Blade Zero - 15 Things To Do After Finishing The Game
